contradictions.title: Protected Disclosure Met With Silence, Not Procedure
contradictions.claim: Brighton Fringe followed proper safeguarding and whistleblowing protocol.
contradictions.reality: Ben Carter issued a formal safeguarding and legal notice to Brighton Fringe on 7 May 2025. The organisation did not respond, did not log a safeguarding record, and took no visible internal action.

contradictions.title: GP Email Used as Retaliation Tool Against Whistleblower
contradictions.claim: Health disclosure was made to protect the individual.
contradictions.reality: Following Ben Carter's protected disclosure on May 7, Brighton Fringe emailed his GP claiming he was paranoid and delusional. This was an unprompted, unsolicited health smear used to reframe the disclosure as instability.

laws.why: Processing special category health data without legal basis
Publication of damaging falsehoods to a third party

contradictions.title: No Trustee Meeting Logged Despite Governance Impact
contradictions.claim: Decisions regarding venue management and safeguarding were handled transparently and within trustee powers.
contradictions.reality: There is no record of any board discussion, minutes, or documented trustee decision justifying the retaliation or management changes. This reflects structural concealment.

laws.why: Interference with private life without lawful process
